about: Side-quest people (stage 3b), written like people.json. They only show up once you've walked in their land ('been_to'), and lost things only while a quest needs them. 'more_talk' adds words to people who live in people.json already: 'start' variants are tried before their own, 'nodes' are new nodes, and 'choices' go in before a node's last choice. phase2/side_steps.py explains it.

say: Whoa! Is that a GREAT sword? Let me look... Perfect edge. Not one wobble!
You're a real smith, {name}. Here, take this armor. I made it on a very good day.
Work? Ha! How about a challenge instead.
Forge a GREAT sword at my anvil: 2 Perfect strikes and no Miss. Hit the marker right in the middle!
Show it to me, and I'll give you a suit of my best armor.
Still trying? Wait for the marker to reach the middle, then strike. Clang!
No more challenges. You beat my best one! I tell everyone about it.
Finn wrote back? 'Dear sister, I do NOT snore.' Ha! He snores like a walrus.
Thank you, {name}. Here's some gold, and two of my best pies.
Oh, would you? My brother, Old Finn, fishes in Lakeside, by the Great Lake.
Could you take him this letter? He never writes back, the old sea cucumber.
The letter goes to Old Finn, in Lakeside. Follow the water!
No errands today, dear. Thank you for the last one!
A letter? From my sister Mabel? Let's see...
'Dear Finn, you snore like a walrus.' I DO NOT! Hmph.
Here, take my answer back to her. And tell her I said hi.
Lily's toy boat? I saw it go by this morning, bobbing along like a little duck.
The wind blew it north, to the shore of the Old Ruins. Look by the water there!
A postcard? For ME? From Juno in the desert!
It says: 'It's so hot here, the lizards wear hats.' Ha ha! Lizards in hats!
Tell Juno thank you! And that Whiskers says meow.
It's so hot here! Even the lizards wear hats.
I made a postcard for my pen pal Pip, in Meadowbrook. Could you take it to him?
Pip lives in Meadowbrook, in Home Meadow. Don't let the postcard melt!
Pip liked it? And Whiskers said meow? Yay!
Here's my allowance. And some dates from the palm tree. Yum!
Hello, dearie! I want to bake my famous berry pie, but my knees are too creaky for berry picking.
Could you bring me 3 food? Press SPACE in a forest to look for berries.
Ooh, those look juicy! Are they for my pie?
I need 3 food for the pie, dearie. You have {food}.
Mmm, smell that? The whole village came for a slice!
Bless you! Mind the spiders in the woods.
Thank you, {name}! I knitted you a lucky scarf while I waited.
Wear it, and you'll always get back up. That's one extra life!
Shh! Hear that? Tip-tap-tip-tap. Spiders! Too many spiders!
They keep stealing my socks to make webs. Could you beat 4 of them?
4 spiders, {name}. Sneak up behind them for a free first hit!
You did it! My socks are safe!
Here's a treasure map. A lookout tower in these woods watches over a hidden chest. Now you know where!
Not a spider in sight. My socks thank you!
Brave knight! Come back when you've beaten 4.
Arr! Two big Sea Serpents keep splashing my boat, {name}!
Row out on the lake and beat 2 of them. I'll give you my old Great sword.

choices.text: I'll stay on land for now.

say: Beat 2 Sea Serpents out on the water. Build a boat with C if you need one!
Arr, the lake is calm again! Here's my Great sword. It's beaten a hundred serpents!
Well, eleven. But it's still a GREAT sword.
Smooth sailing, thanks to you, {name}!
Watch out, they bite!
My toy boat, Captain Quack, sailed away! The wind took him!
Old Finn sees everything on the lake. Could you ask him where Captain Quack went?
Ask Old Finn! He's right here in Lakeside.
The Old Ruins? That's so far! Please find Captain Quack!
CAPTAIN QUACK! You're home! Thank you, {name}!
Here, take my pocket money. And these arrows I found. Don't tell my mom.
Captain Quack and I sail in the bathtub now. It's safer.
Thank you! Ask Old Finn first!
A little red toy boat, stuck in the weeds. Its flag says: CAPTAIN QUACK.
You pick it up. Time to take it home to Lily in Lakeside!
Oh no, oh no! Frost Wolves keep howling at my goats. Now my goats howl too!
Could you beat 3 Frost Wolves? Then my goats can go back to saying 'Baaa'.
Arooo! ...Sorry, that was one of my goats. Beat 3 Frost Wolves, please!
Baaa! Hear that? My goats are goats again! Thank you, {name}!
I can give you a warm wool coat to wear like armor, or my bag of gold. Which one?
Baaa! (That means thank you, in goat.)
Thank you! Wear something warm. The wolves are fast!
There! Warm and tough. The wolves will bounce right off!
Spend it well! Maybe on a hat. It's cold up here.
I'm making a map of the whole world, but I'm afraid of heights. Eek!
Could you climb a lookout tower in Frost Peaks, and dig up the treasure you see from the top?
Find a wooden lookout tower in Frost Peaks and press SPACE on it to climb.
You saw a chest from up there? Go and dig it up! Press SPACE on it.
Treasure! And now I can draw it on my map. X marks the spot!
Here's some gold, and a copy of my map of the desert. There's a hidden chest on it!
My map is almost done. I drew you on it too! You're the little knight.
Hooray! Don't look down!
Ouch! Ouch! A Scorpion pinched my toe, {name}! And then two more pinched my OTHER toe!
Could you beat 3 Scorpions? I'll pay you in gold and arrows.

choices.text: Your toes are safe with me!

say: 3 Scorpions! Watch your toes!
No more pinching! My toes are doing a happy dance.
Here's your gold, and 10 arrows. Shoot straight!
Wiggle wiggle. Happy toes!
Wear shoes. Trust me.
Bubble, bubble! I'm Madame Bubbles, the best potion maker in the swamp. The ONLY one, too.
Bring me 5 wood for my fire and 2 food for the potion, and I'll brew you something magic!
Wood and food! Into the pot... bubble, bubble, POP!
A lucky potion! Will you drink it for an extra life, or sell it to me for 60 gold?
I need 5 wood and 2 food. You have {wood} wood and {food} food.
Bubble, bubble! Come back any time.
Wonderful! Chop trees with T, and look for berries in forests.
Gulp gulp... BURP! You burp a little rainbow. You feel lucky!
A fine potion! I'll sell it to a frog for 61 gold. Hee hee!
Have you seen Sir Hops? He's my frog. He wears a tiny crown.
He always leaves me a clue when he goes on an adventure. Last time it was on the lookout tower!
The clue might be on the lookout tower, west of here in the swamp.
Home Meadow? He wanted to see the big pond there! Silly frog.
Sir Hops is home! He says 'Ribbit.' That means thank you.
He also brought you this soggy map. It shows a hidden chest in the swamp!
Ribbit! (That was Sir Hops. He likes you.)
Thank you! Look for a little bag by the lookout tower.
A tiny bag with a note inside, in very wobbly frog writing:
'Gone to see the big pond in Home Meadow. Back for supper. Ribbit. - Sir Hops'
Ribbit! A little frog in a tiny crown, sitting by the pond.
You tell him Wren misses him. He hops off home to Bogwater, fast as a frog can go!
